series_books.title: Decodable Stories for Early Readers, Book 1
series_books.subtitle: Seven Short Phonics Tales, From Short A to SH and CH, With Sound Lists to Practice Together
series_books.description:
Your child has learned some letter sounds. Now they need something to read that only uses those sounds, so every word can be sounded out and every page feels like a win.

This book has seven short decodable stories that build one step at a time:
- Story 1: short a (A Cat Nap)
- Story 2: short i (Pip Can Dig)
- Story 3: short o (The Hot Pot)
- Story 4: short e (Get Set, Ted)
- Story 5: short u (Bud and the Bus)
- Story 6: sh, ck, ll and ss (The Fish Shop)
- Story 7: ch and th (Chip and the Chick)

Each story starts with its sound list and its few tricky words to practise first, and ends with two questions to talk about. A short note for grown-ups explains how to read together, what to do when a word is hard, and when to move on.

For children about four to seven who are starting to blend sounds, at home or alongside school. This is reading practice, not a program or a treatment for any learning difference.

Published by Spry Labs, the makers of Time-2-Read.

series_books._layout_why: ENGINE: a children's story book, not a workbook. Each '# ' is a story; '## Sounds in this story' and '## Tricky words' are short boxed lists before it; story lines are short paragraphs set large (one or two sentences per paragraph), page break between stories.
